name.ja: BB戦士311 趙雲ガンダム・飛影閃

brands.ja: SD ガンダム BB戦士

description.ja: 疾風の銀槍“趙雲ガンダム”がBB戦士になって遂に登場！ “飛影閃（ひえいせん）”に騎乗可能！また飛影閃にはいろんな武将の武装を装着可能 “オーラの龍”は組み換えて趙雲ガンダムに装着可能 二本の槍とオーラの龍を組み合わせて必殺技「龍撃導」を再現可能 必殺技専用の目シールが付属
description.en: The silver spear of the gale “Zhao Yun Gundam” has finally appeared as a BB Senshi! You can ride “Hieisen”! Also, Hieisen can be equipped with the weapons of various military commanders. The “Aura Dragon” can be rearranged and attached to Choun Gundam. The special move “Dragon Strike Guide” can be recreated by combining the two spears and the Aura Dragon. An eye seal dedicated to the special move is included.
